sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 386 (148 of 152 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day campsite reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. The park states a 2-night minimum for camping reservations (no 1-night exception is posted here). Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. The reservation holder (18+) must be present throughout the stay; two vehicles per site.

Walk-ins are permitted on campsites only'; LENGTH OF STAY), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All but the 13 primitive sites have electric: of 148 campsites listed, 56 at 50 A and 79 at 30 A. No full-hookup sites.
